meta.name: Oligon Scientific Brand
meta.description: Oklch tonal-ramp brand tokens for scientific figures, presentations, documents, and digital assets
breaking_changes_from_v4: Flat contrast_orange #E8622D replaced by Orange tonal ramp (500=#C45E39, 600=#A0421D, 700=#772E11)
medium_blue #158BBB removed; use blue.500 #008ECB for categorical series
Cycle 1 (treatment/control) restructured to same-hue pair: brand.blue + blue.300 (was blue + dark gray)
Cycle 2 split into Peer (equal-weight) and Focus (one promoted) variants
Cycle 3 opposing pair is blue.600 + orange.600 (was brand.blue + #E8622D)
Divergent colormap is blue.700 -> white -> orange.700 (was 5-stop dark teal -> blue -> white -> orange -> dark warm)
Figure type scale updated: title 12pt/700, axis 10pt/500, tick 9pt/400, legend 8.5-9pt/400

philosophy.core_principle: Neutrals are default; Brand Blue highlights the one or two elements that matter most; Orange supplies opposition or focus.
decision_rules: Rule 1 - Choose the cycle from the data's categorical structure (treatment/control, peer, focus, opposing, divergent, multi-category).
Rule 2 - Choose the ramp step from each mark's visual role (fills=50-200, light data=300, primary=400, emphasis=500-600, text/borders=700, dark ground=800-900).
guidelines: Most data draws from the neutral ramp; Brand Blue or Blue 400-700 is reserved for 1-2 elements per panel.
Every figure must remain interpretable in grayscale and under deuteranopia / protanopia simulation.
Category is never encoded by hue alone - combine color with shape, line style, or direct label.
Zero baseline on bar charts; log scales labeled on-figure; uncertainty always shown.

200.role: Cycle 2 Peer lightest arm, Cycle 2 Focus receding

300.role: Cycle 1 control, Cycle 2 Peer/Focus light stroke

400.role: Primary data default (Oklch twin of brand.blue)

500.role: Cycle 2 Focus receding, Cycle 4 mid arm, emphasis

700.role: Accent (links, primary buttons), divergent negative extreme

800.role: Cycle 2 Peer darkest arm, Cycle 4 dark arm, dark surface

500.role: Cycle 2 Focus default promotion, Cycle 4 categorical outlier

700.role: Signal/destructive text, divergent positive extreme, button on dark

50.role: Surface fill (cards, callouts, zebra rows), dark-theme text

200.role: Borders, rules, input outlines, axis furniture

brand_blue.role: Oligon brand anchor - logo, Cycle 1 treatment arm, primary data of interest
brand_blue.note: Reserved for logos and Cycle 1 treatment. Use ramp steps everywhere else.

treatment_control.description: Two-arm study, treatment carries the narrative. Same-hue pair with lightness hierarchy.
treatment_control.when: Treatment vs control; any 2-arm design where one arm is the answer.

peer.description: N equal-weight arms; no arm carries the narrative. Blue ramp at stepped lightness; no promotion.
peer.when: Sibling siRNAs, cell lines, dose levels where ordering is arbitrary.

focus.description: N arms with one promoted. Three background arms in receding Blue, focus arm in configurable intensity.
focus.when: Narrative answer is one arm of a larger set.
focus.assignments: blue.500/300/200 receding + focus variant for promoted arm

opposing.description: Signed or directional effects. Blue + Orange paired across the ramp.
opposing.when: Up vs down, gain vs loss, positive vs negative effects.

multi_category.description: 3-4 categories with one conceptually distinct (e.g. vehicle vs compounds). If all categories are peers, use `peer` instead.
multi_category.when: Multi-compound screens, condition sets with one outlier.
multi_category.assignments: blue.800/500/300 for peer categories + orange.500 for conceptual outlier
multi_category.note: Marker shapes MANDATORY for accessibility. If 5+ categories, redesign using faceting.

ramp_role_mapping.50_200: Fills, tints, surfaces - CI bands, box fills, callout backgrounds
ramp_role_mapping.300: Light data strokes - Cycle 1 control, Cycle 2 Focus receding arms
ramp_role_mapping.400: Primary data - default for lines and markers
ramp_role_mapping.500_600: Emphasis / button fills - CTAs, hover states
ramp_role_mapping.700: Text, borders, links - axis titles on light theme, heatmap extremes
ramp_role_mapping.800_900: Dark page, deepest contrast - dark theme background, monochromatic Focus promotion

divergent_colormap.description: For heatmaps with data centered at zero (z-scores, log2 fold change). Matched lightness curves on both ramps keep perceptual distance from zero symmetric.
requirements: Center the colormap at zero - do not let auto-scaling shift the neutral point
Use symmetric limits when data spans both signs (e.g. -5 to +5 even if range is -3 to +5)
Always include a colorbar with ticks at meaningful intervals

font_family.note: DejaVu Sans is the cross-platform render target for matplotlib and ReportLab.

figure_scale.note: Applies to figures rendered at document scale (print, PDF, web, 60-80cm reading). Projected slides use projection_scale.

axis_label.note: Re-label in PowerPoint or scale figure up if native axis labels fall below 18pt at projected size

projection_scale.context: Projected slides (conference rooms, lecture halls). Document figure sizes disappear from the back row.

legend.location: inside plot area in empty region

aspect_ratios.rule: Match to the data, not the canvas.
aspect_ratios.trend_data: Banked so the mean slope sits near 45 degrees (Cleveland).
aspect_ratios.warning: Do not stretch or squash to fill slide real estate - distorts perceived rate.

figure_integrity_rules.detail: Bars encode quantity by length; truncated y-axis inflates differences. If truncation is unavoidable, switch to a dot plot or Cleveland dot plot.
Axis title reads 'log10 concentration (nM)' or equivalent, with one tick per decade as the base case. Never a silent log transform.
Error bars, CI bands, or individual points overlaid on summary statistics. Bar definition (SD, SEM, or 95% CI) stated on-figure in caption or legend.
3D bars, 3D pies, and drop shadows distort perceived area and introduce perspective error. Flat, 2D, always.

figure_integrity_rules.rule: No rainbow / jet colormaps on continuous data
figure_integrity_rules.detail: Rainbow has no perceptual ordering, introduces false luminance bands, and fails both CVD and grayscale. Use viridis-family or the divergent cycle for continuous scalars.

figure_integrity_rules.rule: No category encoded by hue alone
figure_integrity_rules.detail: Combine color with shape (circle / square / triangle), line style, or direct label so the encoding survives grayscale printing, low-quality projection, and color vision deficiency.
To show a 5:1 ratio, draw five icons beside one icon. Never one icon scaled 5x larger - area-vs-height scaling visually overstates the difference.
Dual y-axes invite spurious visual correlation between independently-scaled series. Reach for small multiples or a twin-panel layout first.

resolution.note: Vector formats (PDF, EPS, SVG) are preferred for line-based figures - scale without quality loss.

accessibility.standard: WCAG 2.1 Level AA (most pairs below reach AAA)
accessibility.colorblind_safe: Blue + Orange axis preserves dark-light differential under deuteranopia and protanopia because both ramps share Oklch lightness curves.
figure_checklist: No category encoded by hue alone - shape, line style, or label also distinguishes
All text >= 9 pt at rendered size, AA contrast verified
Cycle documented in caption or YAML metadata
Alt text describes the FINDING, not the chart type (e.g. 'Bar chart shows a 2-fold increase in cell viability for the treatment group' - not 'image of a bar chart')

usage_rules: DO use Brand Blue wordmark on white, Neutral 50, or Neutral 100.
DO use White wordmark on Blue 700+ or Neutral 800+.
DO NOT rotate, skew, or place on low-contrast tinted backgrounds (Blue 300-500).
DO NOT include logos on publication figures - journals prohibit branding.
Use logos only on presentations, posters, and internal documents.

rules: v[N] segment is required - iterate v1 -> v2 -> v3.
Preserve prior versions until explicitly retired; never overwrite.
Year-month alone cannot disambiguate two iterations in the same month.

preflight_checklist: White background (#FFFFFF) / brand ground (blue.900 for dark theme)
Axis furniture in neutral.200-300; text in neutral.900 on light, neutral.50 on dark
Correct cycle for scientific context (Rule 1) and correct ramp step for visual role (Rule 2)
Brand Blue limited to 1-2 focal elements per panel
No library default colors; no retired v4 hexes (#E8622D, #7D250F, #0F5D7D, #158BBB)
Tested in grayscale and under CVD simulation
Uncertainty rendered and labeled (SEM/SD/95% CI, n=?)
Font: Arial / Helvetica / DejaVu Sans; figure scale 9-12pt, projection scale >= 18pt
Resolution >= 300 DPI for print; vector preferred for line art
Alt text describes the finding, not the chart type
